caption:
How do you find a planet this young? (In archival Keck data from 2018 and 2020. Nobody pointed a new telescope at it.)
Astrophysical Journal Letters, 16 Sept 2026. Bernardi, Cieza, Universidad Diego Portales.

Elias 2-24 b is the youngest planet ever found: under 1 million years old, still inside the disk it formed from, about 450 light-years away and about 55 au from its star. The previous youngest planets are all over 5 million years old; Earth is 4.5 billion. Roughly Jupiter's mass, though models give about 2 to 4. Andrea Bernardi's team at Universidad Diego Portales found it in Keck images taken in 2018 and 2020 that nobody had looked at this way. Images are generated illustrations.

#space #astronomy #exoplanet #science
